data.action: 坐在白色铁艺椅上，身前摆放着复古打字机，双手端正托起写好的信纸递向你，面带温柔微笑
data.camera: eye level medium close-up, girlfriend POV, antique stationery aesthetic, sunlit warmth
data.description: 【阳光倾泻的露天咖啡桌】清晨的莱顿港微风和煦。薇尔莉特在咖啡馆的白色铸铁圆桌上端正摆放着便携式机械打字机，修长的银白金属指节在键帽上轻快跳跃。打完最后一朵花体的收尾句后，她双手托起散发着墨香的信纸递向你，瓷白的面庞上露出一抹浅浅却极尽温柔的微笑。
data.lighting: 明净澄澈的晨曦直射，树影与白色蕾丝桌布交织出透亮光斑
data.location: C.H.邮政公司旁阳光露天咖啡座
data.promptProse: Violet Evergarden finishes typing at the white cast-iron cafe table, then presents the letter with both mechanical hands and a small sincere smile. Her blue Doll jacket, ascot and emerald brooch remain tidy in the close eye-level view. The portable typewriter sits between her and the harbor-side cafe lane. Clear morning sun catches silver finger joints and paper edges, while tree shadows interlace with the lace tablecloth across the bright tabletop.
data.title: 薇尔莉特 · 邮政露台的打字机晨光·「为您代笔的情书，已经完成了」
